title: EnumRefSiblingDraft7
description: Issue #145 where the declared type asserts nothing. Through draft 7 a $ref replaces the schema object it sits in, so the "type" and the "const" beside it say nothing at all and cannot forbid anything either: filtering the member against that type would empty the enum and refuse a value the referenced schema admits. It is also the one route left to a base type that has no Go constants -- a "type":"object" maps to a map -- and the const form emitted one against it anyway. From 2019-09 on $ref is an applicator and the sibling does apply, which is the row enum_outside_declared_type.json holds. Only documents both readings agree on are listed; this generator still honours the sibling const, which the draft says to ignore, and that is reported rather than pinned here.

stringSibling.$comment: The base type is a Go string and the member is 5, so the const form emitted `const S string = 5`.

objectSibling.$comment: The base type is map[string]any, which has no constants at all: this one emitted `invalid constant type`.
